messages:
maya: saw a p99 jump on the dashboard for /ingest-path after the canary. endpoint p99 steady but that path went 300ms -> 820ms.
liam: do you have the console query? we added is_retry recently which could affect rollups.
maya: query: ```select percentile(0.99, duration_ms) from requests where ingress_path='/ingest-path' and time >= now()-interval '1 hour'```
arthur: retries are tagged is_retry=true but rollup merge ignores that dim so p99 can be biased.
jess: UX: exclude retries by default for SLO tiles, add "Include retries" toggle on diagnostics + show retry_ratio in tooltip.
telemetry-bot: note: is_retry indexed 2026-03-22T04:12:00Z.
liam: I checked excluding retries and p99 drops to ~340ms. will open telemetry and console tickets.
maya: please also confirm backfill impact before flipping defaults.
arthur: will run backfill validation and post a short runbook.
liam: created telemetry#4325 and console#990.
maya: thanks everyone, moving card to in-progress.
